
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/22302141" title="发布于 2026-08-07 13:16">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">6. Agent一句话截真机屏：截图Tool这样写</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>配套动画视频在：<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1hEgv6VEsY/" rel="noopener nofollow">《6. Agent一句话截真机屏：截图Tool这样写》</a>。</p>
<p>前面几节把读文档、生成用例这条链路打通了。自动化测试里还有一块绕不开：对着真机截屏。这一节就写截图 Tool——Agent 说一句话，就能把当前屏幕落到本地。</p>
<p>整条链路可以先记个轮廓：先在 .env 里配好 HDC_PATH，再在 json 里写上设备 sn；配置就绪后解析 hdc、检查设备——没设备就失败返回，有设备就截图并拉回本地；文件为空也算失败，成功则保存到 screenshots。Agent 一句话截屏，跑的就是这条链路。下面按关键段落过一遍。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260807103012766-1621057480.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;先找 hdc 在哪。_get_hdc_cmd 优先看 HDC_PATH（文件或目录），找不到再退回系统 PATH 里的 hdc：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> _get_hdc_cmd() -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list:
    ...
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hdc</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>]</pre>
</div>
<p>核心截图函数 _do_take_screenshot 一进来，先拼好 hdc 命令；有 device_id 就加上 -t：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>hdc_cmd =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _get_hdc_cmd()
hdc_prefix </span>= hdc_cmd + ([<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-t</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, device_id] <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> device_id <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> [])</pre>
</div>
<p>本地保存路径也要处理好。传进来的若是目录，就自动建目录并用时间戳拼文件名；若是文件路径，只保证父目录存在：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> save_file.is_dir() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> (save_file.suffix == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> save_file.name):
    ...
    save_file </span>= save_file /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> fname
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    save_file.parent.mkdir(parents</span>=True, exist_ok=True)</pre>
</div>
<p>设备端截图时，临时路径固定。先试新命令 snapshot_display，再试旧命令 screenshot；两个都失败就返回 None：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>remote_path = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/data/local/tmp/tmp_screenshot.jpeg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
...
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> cmd <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [
    hdc_prefix </span>+ [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">shell</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">snapshot_display</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, remote_path],
    hdc_prefix </span>+ [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">shell</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">screenshot</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, remote_path],
]:
    ...
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> screenshot_ok:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> None</pre>
</div>
<p>截完后用 <span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="file" data-pretit="file">file recv 拉回电脑。本地文件存在且非空才返回路径，异常统一返回 None：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">subprocess.run(
    hdc_prefix </span>+ [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">file</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">recv</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, remote_path, str(save_file)],
    ...
)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> save_file.exists() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span> save_file.stat().st_size &gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> str(save_file)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span> Exception:</pre>
</div>
<p>工具侧，TakeScreenshotInput 声明参数 schema：设备 ID 可选，保存路径必填。TakeScreenshotTool 名字叫 take_screenshot，description 里写清干什么、参数怎么用，Agent 才知道何时调用。</p>
<p>_run 里先做路径规范化——相对路径一律接到项目根目录，已是绝对路径则原样使用：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>base_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__file__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> save_path.startswith(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
    save_path </span>= os.path.normpath(os.path.join(base_dir, save_path.lstrip(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.isabs(save_path):
    save_path </span>= os.path.normpath(os.path.join(base_dir, save_path))</pre>
</div>
<p>接着做前置检查：跑一遍 hdc list targets。工具不可用，或没连上设备，直接返回中文错误：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>check =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> subprocess.run(
    hdc_prefix </span>+ [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">list</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">targets</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
    ...
)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> check.returncode !=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">错误：hdc工具不可用 - ...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span> output <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">No device</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> output <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">无设备</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> output:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">错误：未检测到连接的HarmonyOS设备</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
</div>
<p>检查通过后调用底层截图。成功报路径和大小；失败、超时、hdc 找不到，则分别返回对应提示：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>result_path =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _do_take_screenshot(save_path, device_id)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> result_path:
    ...
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">截图成功，保存至：{result_path} ({file_size} bytes)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">错误：截图失败</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">错误：截图超时(&gt;15秒)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
...</span></pre>
</div>
<p>熟悉截图 Tool 之后，改一下触发工具的提示词，表达清楚就可以了：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> main():
    agent </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_test_agent()
    result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> agent.invoke({
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [{<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">使用 take_screenshot 工具对当前设备屏幕截一张图，保存到 testcases/screenshots/app_screenshot.png 。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}]
    })
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(result[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>][-1].content[0][<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>])</pre>
</div>
<p>完整test_tools.py的代码如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> subprocess
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> typing <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Optional, Type
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> pathlib <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Path

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> pydantic <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BaseModel, Field
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.tools <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BaseTool
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> yaml
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
B站、抖音：@老陈说编程
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GenerateTestCasesInput(BaseModel):
    test_cases: list </span>= Field(description=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">测试用例列表，每个用例含 case_id, case_name, description, steps</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    output_path: str </span>= Field(description=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">YAML文件输出路径</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GenerateTestCasesTool(BaseTool):
    name: str </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">generate_test_cases</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    description: str </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">将测试用例列表保存为YAML文件。用例格式：每个用例包含case_id(用例ID)、case_name(用例名称)、description(描述)、steps(步骤列表)。每个step包含action(操作类型:click/input/clear/assert_exists/assert_not_exists/assert_text/assert_toast/wait/screenshot/swipe/back)和params(参数字典，含selector元素ID)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    args_schema: Type[BaseModel] </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GenerateTestCasesInput
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> _run(self, test_cases: list, output_path: str) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> str:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            base_dir </span>= os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__file__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> output_path.startswith(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
                output_path </span>= os.path.normpath(os.path.join(base_dir, output_path.lstrip(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)))
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.isabs(output_path):
                output_path </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.normpath(os.path.join(base_dir, output_path))
 
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i, case <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> enumerate(test_cases):
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">case_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> case <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">steps</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> case:
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">错误：第{i + 1}个用例缺少case_id或steps</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            output_file </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Path(output_path)
            output_file.parent.mkdir(parents</span>=True, exist_ok=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True)
            with open(output_file, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">w</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, encoding=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) as f:
                yaml.dump({</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">test_cases</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: test_cases}, f, allow_unicode=True, default_flow_style=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">False)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">成功保存{len(test_cases)}个用例至：{output_path}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">保存失败：{str(e)}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
 
<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
B站、抖音：@老陈说编程
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span> 
 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> _get_hdc_cmd() -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
    获取 hdc 命令路径
    hdc（HarmonyOS Device Connector）是 HarmonyOS 的命令行工具，用于与设备通信。
    本函数按以下优先级查找 hdc：
    1. 优先使用环境变量 HDC_PATH 指定的路径（可以是可执行文件或目录）
    2. 如果未配置环境变量或找不到，直接使用 'hdc'（依赖系统 PATH）
    Returns:
        list: hdc 命令列表，例如 ['hdc'] 或 ['C:\\path\\to\\hdc.exe']
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 从环境变量获取 HDC_PATH 配置</span>
    hdc_path = os.environ.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">HDC_PATH</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> hdc_path:
        p </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Path(hdc_path)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果 HDC_PATH 直接指向一个文件，返回该文件路径</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> p.is_file():
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [str(p)]
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果 HDC_PATH 是一个目录，在目录下查找 hdc.exe（Windows）或 hdc</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> p.is_dir():
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> name <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hdc.exe</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hdc</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]:
                exe </span>= p /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> exe.exists():
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [str(exe)]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 默认使用系统 PATH 中的 hdc 命令</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hdc</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> _do_take_screenshot(save_path: str, device_id: Optional[str] = None, label: str = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Optional[str]:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
    统一的截图底层实
    完整流程：
    1. 解析保存路径（支持传目录或完整文件路径）
    2. 在设备端执行截图命令（优先 snapshot_display，兼容旧版 screenshot）
    3. 验证截图是否在设备端成功生成
    4. 将截图从设备拉取到本地
    5. 验证本地文件有效性
    Args:
        save_path: 保存文件路径或目录
            - 如果是目录（如 'testcases/screenshots/'），自动生成带时间戳的文件名
            - 如果是完整路径（如 'testcases/screenshots/before.png'），直接使用该路径
        device_id: 设备ID（可选）
            - 如果有多个设备连接，通过此参数指定目标设备
            - 如果为 None，使用默认设备
        label: 截图标签（仅当 save_path 是目录时使用）
            - 用于自动生成文件名，例如 label='before' → 'before_20260723_160000.png'
    Returns:
        成功: 返回截图文件的绝对路径（字符串）
        失败: 返回 None
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取 hdc 基础命令</span>
        hdc_cmd =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _get_hdc_cmd()
 
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 构建设备前缀命令：如果指定了 device_id，添加 '-t &lt;device_id&gt;' 参数</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 例如 ['hdc', '-t', '2L1111110223916']</span>
        hdc_prefix = hdc_cmd + ([<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-t</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, device_id] <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> device_id <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [])
 
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 步骤1：解析并准备本地保存路径 ==========</span>
        save_file =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Path(save_path)
 
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 判断 save_path 是目录还是文件路径：</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> - 如果是已存在的目录</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> - 或者路径没有后缀名（没有 '.'），也视为目录</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> save_file.is_dir() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> (save_file.suffix == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> save_file.name):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 自动创建目录（parents=True 允许递归创建，exist_ok=True 目录已存在不报错）</span>
            save_file.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 生成时间戳，格式：年月日_时分秒（例如 20260723_160000）</span>
            timestamp = datetime.now().strftime(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%Y%m%d_%H%M%S</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 生成文件名：有 label 时用 label_时间戳.png，否则用 screenshot_时间戳.png</span>
            fname = f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{label}_{timestamp}.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> label <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">screenshot_{timestamp}.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 拼接完整文件路径</span>
            save_file = save_file /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> fname
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果是文件路径，确保父目录存在</span>
            save_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True)
 
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 步骤2：设备端临时路径 ==========</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> HarmonyOS 设备上的临时截图保存位置（应用沙盒外的公共临时目录）</span>
        remote_path = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/data/local/tmp/tmp_screenshot.jpeg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
 
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 步骤3：在设备端执行截图命令（兼容新旧版本） ==========</span>
        screenshot_ok =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> False
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 尝试两种截图命令：</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. snapshot_display：新版 HarmonyOS 的截图命令（API 9+）</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. screenshot：旧版兼容命令</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> cmd <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [
            hdc_prefix </span>+ [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">shell</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">snapshot_display</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, remote_path],
            hdc_prefix </span>+ [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">shell</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">screenshot</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, remote_path],
        ]:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 执行截图命令，超时时间 15 秒</span>
            r =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> subprocess.run(
                cmd, capture_output</span>=True, text=True, timeout=15<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                encoding</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, errors=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">replace</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            )
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 合并 stdout 和 stderr，转为小写用于错误检测</span>
            combined = (r.stdout +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> r.stderr).lower()
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检查命令是否执行成功：</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> - 返回码为 0</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> - 输出中不包含 'fail' 或 'error' 关键字</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> r.returncode == 0 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">fail</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> combined <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">error</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> combined:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 步骤4：验证设备端截图文件确实生成了 ==========</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 执行 ls -l 命令检查文件是否存在、大小是否正常</span>
                check =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> subprocess.run(
                    hdc_prefix </span>+ [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">shell</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ls</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-l</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, remote_path],
                    capture_output</span>=True, text=True, timeout=5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                    encoding</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, errors=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">replace</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                )
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 再次验证：ls 命令成功、没有 "No such file"、文件名出现在输出中</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> check.returncode == 0 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">No such file</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> check.stdout <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span> remote_path.split(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>)[-1] <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> check.stdout:
                    screenshot_ok </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> True
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 截图成功，跳出循环</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span>
 
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果两种命令都失败了，直接返回 None</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> screenshot_ok:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None
 
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 步骤5：将截图从设备拉取到本地 ==========</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用 hdc file recv 命令：从设备接收文件到本地</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 命令格式：hdc file recv &lt;设备端路径&gt; &lt;本地路径&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        subprocess.run(
            hdc_prefix </span>+ [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">file</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">recv</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, remote_path, str(save_file)],
            capture_output</span>=True, text=True, timeout=10<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            encoding</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, errors=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">replace</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        )
 
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 步骤6：验证本地文件有效性 ==========</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检查文件是否存在，并且文件大小大于 0（避免空文件）</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> save_file.exists() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span> save_file.stat().st_size &gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 返回绝对路径字符串</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> str(save_file)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 文件无效，返回 None</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 捕获所有异常（超时、文件IO错误等），统一返回 None</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TakeScreenshotInput(BaseModel):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
    TakeScreenshotTool 的参数定义模型
    使用 Pydantic BaseModel 定义工具的输入参数 schema，
    LangChain 会自动根据这个模型生成参数描述和验证。
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设备ID，可选参数，默认 None（使用默认设备）</span>
    device_id: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">设备ID(可选)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 截图保存路径，必填参数</span>
    save_path: str = Field(description=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">截图保存路径</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TakeScreenshotTool(BaseTool):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
    HarmonyOS 截图工具（LangChain Tool 封装）
    这是供 DeepAgent 调用的工具类，Agent 通过调用 take_screenshot 工具来截取设备屏幕。
    工具会：
    1. 自动处理相对路径/绝对路径转换（基于项目根目录）
    2. 检查 hdc 工具可用性
    3. 检查设备连接状态
    4. 调用底层 _do_take_screenshot 执行实际截图
    5. 返回友好的成功/失败信息（包含文件路径和大小）
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 工具名称（Agent 通过此名称调用工具）</span>
    name: str = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">take_screenshot</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 工具描述（Agent 会根据此描述理解工具用途和参数）</span>
    description: str = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">对HarmonyOS设备当前屏幕截图并保存到本地文件。参数save_path为截图保存的本地路径（建议testcases/screenshots/目录下）。成功返回文件路径和大小，失败返回错误信息。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 参数 schema，指向上面定义的 TakeScreenshotInput</span>
    args_schema: Type[BaseModel] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TakeScreenshotInput
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> _run(self, save_path: str, device_id: Optional[str] = None) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> str:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
        工具执行入口（LangChain 调用此方法）
        Args:
            save_path: 截图保存路径（可以是相对路径或绝对路径）
            device_id: 设备ID（可选）
        Returns:
            str: 执行结果消息
                - 成功："截图成功，保存至：&lt;绝对路径&gt; (&lt;文件大小&gt; bytes)"
                - 失败："错误：&lt;错误原因&gt;"
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 步骤1：路径规范化处理 ==========</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取当前文件所在目录（项目根目录）</span>
            base_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__file__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
 
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将传入的路径转换为绝对路径：</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> save_path.startswith(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果以 '/' 开头，视为相对于项目根目录的路径（去掉开头的 / 后拼接）</span>
                save_path = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(base_dir, save_path.lstrip(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)))
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.isabs(save_path):
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果是相对路径（不以 / 开头，也不是 Windows 绝对路径如 C:\），</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 基于项目根目录拼接成绝对路径</span>
                save_path =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.normpath(os.path.join(base_dir, save_path))
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果已经是绝对路径（Windows 如 E:\...），直接使用</span>
 
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 步骤2：准备 hdc 命令 ==========</span>
            hdc_cmd =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _get_hdc_cmd()
            hdc_prefix </span>= hdc_cmd + ([<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-t</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, device_id] <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> device_id <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [])
 
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 步骤3：前置检查 - hdc 可用性和设备连接 ==========</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 执行 'hdc list targets' 命令列出已连接设备</span>
            check =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> subprocess.run(
                hdc_prefix </span>+ [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">list</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">targets</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
                capture_output</span>=True, text=True, timeout=5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                encoding</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, errors=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">replace</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            )
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检查 hdc 命令本身是否可用</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> check.returncode !=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">错误：hdc工具不可用 - {check.stderr.strip() or check.stdout.strip()}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            output </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> check.stdout.strip()
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检查是否有设备连接</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> hdc list targets 在无设备时可能输出 "No device"、空行、或 "无设备"</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span> output <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">No device</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> output <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">无设备</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> output:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">错误：未检测到连接的HarmonyOS设备</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
 
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 步骤4：执行截图 ==========</span>
            result_path =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _do_take_screenshot(save_path, device_id)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> result_path:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 截图成功：获取文件大小，返回成功消息</span>
                save_file =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Path(result_path)
                file_size </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> save_file.stat().st_size
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">截图成功，保存至：{result_path} ({file_size} bytes)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 截图失败</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">错误：截图失败</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
 
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 命令执行超时</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">错误：截图超时(&gt;15秒)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FileNotFoundError:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> hdc 命令未找到（系统找不到 hdc.exe）</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">错误：hdc命令未找到，请确保已安装HarmonyOS SDK并配置HDC_PATH环境变量</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 其他未知异常</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">截图失败：{str(e)}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> get_all_tools() -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [
        GenerateTestCasesTool(),
        TakeScreenshotTool()
    ]</span></pre>
</div>
<p>完整run_automation_test.py的代码如下：</p>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> deepagents <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_deep_agent
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> test_tools <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> get_all_tools
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
B站、抖音：@老陈说编程

    result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> agent.invoke({
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [{<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">使用take_screentshot工具对当前设备屏幕截一张，</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>

    })
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(result[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>][-1].content[0][<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__name__</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">__main__</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    main()</span></pre>
</div>
<p>跑起来后，Agent 会调用 take_screenshot，把当前屏幕保存到指定路径。有了这步，后面的启停应用、测前测后截图才有落点。</p>
<p>配套动画视频在：<a class="link-info" title="《6. Agent一句话截真机屏：截图Tool这样写》" href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1hEgv6VEsY/" rel="noopener nofollow">《6. Agent一句话截真机屏：截图Tool这样写》</a>。</p>
